The Stylistics featuring Russell Thompkins, Jr. – Betcha By Golly, Wow / Ebony Eyes

Original 1972 Avco Records 45 RPM single featuring the timeless soul classic "Betcha By Golly, Wow" backed with "Ebony Eyes." Produced and arranged by Thom Bell, this is one of The Stylistics' signature recordings and a must-have for fans of Philadelphia soul.

This is an authentic vintage pressing, not a modern reissue.

Record Details

  • Artist: The Stylistics featuring Russell Thompkins, Jr.
  • Title: Betcha By Golly, Wow
  • B-Side: Ebony Eyes
  • Label: Avco Records
  • Catalog Number: AV-4591
  • Format: 7" Vinyl Single
  • Speed: 45 RPM
  • Country: USA
  • Year: 1972
  • Genre: Soul / R&B

Track Listing

Side A

  • Betcha By Golly, Wow

Side B

  • Ebony Eyes

Condition Notes

  • Vinyl retains a nice gloss with light to moderate cosmetic wear from normal handling and play.
  • Surface scratches and sleeve scuffs are visible but nothing appears excessive.
  • Labels are clean and easy to read.
  • No cracks, chips, or warping observed.
  • Record has been visually graded and has not been professionally play-tested.
  • Please review all photos carefully, as they are of the exact record you will receive.
